sources.title: YDS: Yabancı Dil Bilgisi Seviye Tespit Sınavı

items.q: Although the company invested heavily in advertising, its sales did not increase as much as the managers had expected.
options: Because the company spent so much money on advertising, its sales rose far beyond what the managers had expected.
The managers expected sales to fall, so the company decided not to invest any money in advertising at all.
The company's sales would have increased considerably if the managers had decided to invest more in advertising.
Sales grew less than the managers had anticipated, even though the company had spent a great deal on advertising.
The managers were surprised that the company's sales increased even though nothing had been invested in advertising.
items.explain_tr: Asıl cümle: şirket reklama çok yatırım yaptı, ama satışlar beklenen kadar artmadı ([en:although] zıtlığı). D seçeneği aynı anlamı [en:even though] ile korur. A satışların beklentiyi aştığını söyleyerek anlamı tersine çevirir; C gerçek olmayan bir koşul ([en:would have increased if]) ekler; E reklama hiç yatırım yapılmadığını söyler.

items.q: Unless governments act quickly to reduce carbon emissions, the effects of climate change may become impossible to reverse within a few decades.
options: Governments have acted quickly to reduce carbon emissions, so the effects of climate change will be reversed within a few decades.
If governments do not take prompt action to cut carbon emissions, climate change could become irreversible in the next few decades.
Even if governments reduce carbon emissions quickly, the effects of climate change cannot be reversed in a few decades.
The effects of climate change became irreversible decades ago because governments failed to reduce carbon emissions.
Governments are unlikely to reduce carbon emissions quickly, since the effects of climate change are already impossible to reverse.
items.explain_tr: [en:Unless] = [en:if … not]: hükûmetler hızla harekete geçmezse iklim değişikliği geri döndürülemez hâle gelebilir; B bunu [en:if … do not] ve [en:could become irreversible] ile aynen verir. C koşulu kaldırıp ([en:even if]) sonucu kesinleştirir; D olayı geçmişe taşır; E ise sonucu neden yapar.

items.q: The study's findings are not as conclusive as the authors claim, since the sample was small and drawn from a single city.
options: The authors admit that their findings are inconclusive because the sample was small and limited to one city.
The study's findings are conclusive despite the fact that the sample was small and drawn from a single city.
The authors claim that a small sample drawn from a single city makes their findings more conclusive.
If the sample had been drawn from a single city, the study's findings would have been as conclusive as the authors claim.
Because the sample was small and came from only one city, the study's findings are less conclusive than the authors suggest.
items.explain_tr: Asıl cümle: bulgular yazarların iddia ettiği kadar kesin değil, çünkü örneklem küçük ve tek şehirden. E aynı nedeni ([en:because]) ve aynı karşılaştırmayı ([en:less conclusive than the authors suggest]) korur. A'da yazarlar bunu kendileri kabul ediyor, oysa asıl cümlede yazarlar bulguları kesin sayıyor; B bulguların kesin olduğunu söyleyerek anlamı tersine çevirir.

items.q: Few people realised at the time how profoundly the invention of the telephone would change the way business was conducted.
options: At the time, hardly anyone understood how deeply the telephone would transform the conduct of business.
At the time, most people recognised that the telephone would completely change the way business was done.
The invention of the telephone changed business far less than people had expected at the time.
Few business people were willing to use the telephone when it was first invented.
People realised only later that the telephone had hardly changed the way business was conducted.
items.explain_tr: [en:Few people realised] = çok az kişi fark etti; A bunu [en:hardly anyone understood] ile, [en:profoundly] sözcüğünü de [en:deeply] ile karşılar. B çoğunluğun fark ettiğini söyleyerek tersine çevirir; C ve E telefonun iş dünyasını az değiştirdiğini ileri sürer, oysa asıl cümlede değişim derindir; D konuyu telefon kullanma isteğine kaydırır.

items.q: The new treatment is far more expensive than the conventional one, but it causes considerably fewer side effects in most patients.
options: The new treatment is both cheaper and safer than the conventional one for most patients.
Because the new treatment causes fewer side effects, it has become more expensive than the conventional one.
Although the new treatment costs much more than the conventional one, most patients suffer far fewer side effects with it.
The conventional treatment is more expensive than the new one, although it causes fewer side effects.
Most patients prefer the conventional treatment, since the new one causes considerably more side effects.
items.explain_tr: Asıl cümlede iki karşıt bilgi var: yeni tedavi çok daha pahalı, ama yan etkisi çok daha az. C bunu [en:although] ile aynen korur. A yeni tedaviyi daha ucuz gösterir; B iki bilgi arasına olmayan bir neden-sonuç ([en:because]) kurar; D ve E hangi tedavinin pahalı ya da yan etkili olduğunu ters çevirir.

items.q: Had the city invested in flood defences a decade ago, the damage caused by last month's storm would have been far less severe.
options: The city invested in flood defences ten years ago, which is why last month's storm caused so little damage.
The damage from last month's storm would not have been nearly so serious if the city had built flood defences ten years ago.
Last month's storm caused little damage, even though the city had not invested in flood defences.
The city will invest in flood defences so that future storms cause far less damage than last month's.
The damage caused by last month's storm would have been even worse if the city had built flood defences ten years ago.
items.explain_tr: [en:Had the city invested …] devrik 3. tip koşuldur: şehir on yıl önce yatırım yapmadı, bu yüzden hasar ağır oldu. B aynı gerçek dışı koşulu [en:if the city had built …] ile kurar. A yatırımın gerçekten yapıldığını ve hasarın az olduğunu söyler; E koşulun sonucunu tersine çevirir ([en:even worse]); D geleceğe yönelik bir plandır.

items.q: Contrary to popular belief, people who read fiction regularly tend to be better at understanding the emotions of others.
options: As most people assume, regular readers of fiction find it harder to understand other people's emotions.
People who are good at understanding others' emotions tend to read fiction more regularly than other people.
It is widely believed that reading fiction regularly makes people better at understanding their own emotions.
Although many people assume otherwise, regular readers of fiction are generally more skilled at recognising other people's feelings.
Reading fiction occasionally is enough to make people better at understanding the emotions of others.
items.explain_tr: [en:Contrary to popular belief] = yaygın inanışın aksine; D bunu [en:although many people assume otherwise] ile, [en:tend to be better at] ifadesini de [en:are generally more skilled at] ile karşılar. A yaygın inanışa uyduğunu ve okurların daha kötü olduğunu söyleyerek tersine çevirir; B özne-sonuç yönünü değiştirir (duyguları anlayanlar daha çok okur); C "kendi duyguları" diyerek nesneyi değiştirir.

items.q: The committee postponed its decision until the full report had been published, rather than relying on the preliminary findings alone.
options: Instead of basing its decision only on the preliminary findings, the committee waited for the full report to be published.
The committee made its decision on the basis of the preliminary findings, since the full report had not yet been published.
The committee rejected the full report and decided to rely on the preliminary findings instead.
After the full report was published, the committee realised that the preliminary findings had been wrong.
The committee published the preliminary findings so that it could reach a decision before the full report appeared.
items.explain_tr: Komite ön bulgulara güvenmek yerine ([en:rather than]) kararı tam rapor yayımlanana kadar erteledi; A bunu [en:instead of] ve [en:waited for the full report] ile aynen verir. B ve C komitenin ön bulgulara dayanarak karar verdiğini söyler, yani tam tersi; D raporun içeriği hakkında asıl cümlede olmayan bir yargı ekler.

items.q: While renewable energy sources are becoming cheaper every year, they still cannot meet the entire demand for electricity in most industrialised countries.
options: Renewable energy sources now meet all the electricity demand in most industrialised countries, because they have become so cheap.
Renewable energy sources are becoming more expensive every year, so most industrialised countries still rely on other sources.
Most industrialised countries refuse to use renewable energy even though it could meet their entire demand for electricity.
Once renewable energy becomes cheaper, it will meet the entire demand for electricity in most industrialised countries.
Despite their falling costs, renewable sources are not yet able to supply all the electricity most industrialised countries need.
items.explain_tr: [en:While] burada zıtlık kurar: yenilenebilir kaynaklar ucuzluyor, ama talebin tamamını hâlâ karşılayamıyor. E aynı zıtlığı [en:despite their falling costs] ve [en:not yet able to supply all] ile korur. A talebin tamamının karşılandığını söyler; B kaynakların pahalılaştığını ileri sürer; D bunu geleceğe ait bir koşula ([en:once … will]) dönüştürür.

items.q: It was not until the results of the second experiment were published that the scientific community began to take the theory seriously.
options: The scientific community took the theory seriously long before the results of the second experiment were published.
The results of the second experiment convinced the scientific community that the theory was wrong.
The scientific community only started to treat the theory seriously after the results of the second experiment appeared.
The scientific community refused to take the theory seriously even after the second experiment was published.
The second experiment was carried out because the scientific community had already accepted the theory.
items.explain_tr: [en:It was not until X that Y] = Y ancak X'ten sonra oldu: bilim dünyası kuramı ancak ikinci deneyin sonuçları yayımlanınca ciddiye almaya başladı. C bunu [en:only started … after] ile aynen verir. A kuramın çok önceden ciddiye alındığını söyler; D ikinci deneyden sonra bile ciddiye alınmadığını ileri sürer; B kuramın yanlış bulunduğunu ekler.

items.q: As the population of the city has grown, so has the pressure on its public transport system, which was designed for far fewer passengers.
options: The city's transport system, built for far fewer passengers, has come under growing strain as the population has risen.
The city's public transport system was expanded in order to cope with the growth of its population.
Although the city's population has grown, its public transport system still has more capacity than it needs.
The city's population has grown because its public transport system was designed to carry a large number of passengers.
The pressure on the city's public transport system has fallen, since far fewer passengers use it than it was designed for.
items.explain_tr: [en:As X has grown, so has Y] = X arttıkça Y de arttı: nüfus büyüdükçe, çok daha az yolcu için tasarlanmış ulaşım sistemi üzerindeki baskı da arttı. A bunu [en:come under growing strain as the population has risen] ile korur. B sistemin genişletildiğini söyler (asıl cümlede yok); C ve E baskının olmadığını ya da azaldığını ileri sürerek anlamı tersine çevirir.

items.q: Even the most experienced doctors occasionally misdiagnose the disease, because its early symptoms closely resemble those of a common cold.
options: Only inexperienced doctors misdiagnose the disease, since its early symptoms are quite different from those of a common cold.
Experienced doctors never confuse the disease with a common cold, although the early symptoms of the two look rather similar.
The disease is often mistaken for a common cold by patients themselves, but experienced doctors always diagnose it correctly.
Because its early symptoms are so like those of a common cold, even very experienced doctors sometimes misidentify the disease.
Doctors frequently diagnose a common cold as the disease, because its later symptoms are so much more severe.
items.explain_tr: Asıl cümle: en deneyimli doktorlar bile hastalığı ara sıra yanlış teşhis ediyor, çünkü erken belirtileri soğuk algınlığına çok benziyor. D aynı nedeni ([en:because]) ve aynı dereceyi ([en:even … sometimes misidentify]) korur. A yalnız deneyimsiz doktorların yanıldığını ve belirtilerin farklı olduğunu söyler; B ve C deneyimli doktorların hiç yanılmadığını ileri sürerek tersine çevirir.

items.q: The author argues that economic growth alone cannot eliminate poverty unless its benefits are distributed more evenly across society.
options: The author believes that economic growth will eliminate poverty regardless of how its benefits are distributed.
According to the author, growth by itself cannot end poverty if its gains are not shared more equally throughout society.
The author claims that distributing wealth more evenly would slow economic growth and therefore increase poverty.
In the author's view, poverty has already been eliminated because the benefits of growth have been shared evenly.
The author suggests that economic growth is unnecessary as long as existing wealth is distributed more evenly.
items.explain_tr: Yazara göre büyüme tek başına yoksulluğu bitiremez; [en:unless] (… olmadıkça) ile bu ancak faydalar daha eşit dağıtılırsa mümkün olur. B bunu [en:cannot end poverty if its gains are not shared more equally] ile aynen verir. A koşulu kaldırıp ([en:regardless of]) büyümenin tek başına yeteceğini söyler; E büyümeyi gereksiz ilan eder; C ve D asıl cümlede olmayan sonuçlar ekler.

items.q: Students who were allowed to choose their own research topics produced noticeably better work than those who were assigned a topic by their teachers.
options: Students produced equally good work whether they chose their own research topics or were given one by their teachers.
Teachers assigned research topics to the students who had produced the best work in the past.
Students who were given a research topic by their teachers did noticeably better than those who chose their own.
Students were allowed to choose their own research topics only after they had produced good work on an assigned one.
Students who picked their own research topics did clearly better work than those whose topics were chosen by their teachers.
items.explain_tr: Asıl cümle bir karşılaştırma yapıyor: konusunu kendi seçen öğrencilerin işi, konusu öğretmence verilenlerinkinden belirgin biçimde daha iyi. E bunu [en:did clearly better work than] ile aynen korur. C karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir; A fark olmadığını söyler; B ve D asıl cümlede olmayan bir zaman sırası ve koşul ekler.

items.q: The museum had to close for two years so that its historic building could be restored, which cost far more than the trustees had originally estimated.
options: The museum closed for two years because the trustees could not afford to pay for restoring its historic building.
The trustees had estimated that restoring the museum's historic building would take two years, but it was completed much sooner.
Restoring the museum's historic building, which meant closing for two years, cost much more than the trustees had first calculated.
The museum remained open during the restoration of its historic building, which cost rather less than the trustees had expected.
The trustees decided to close the museum permanently, since restoring its historic building would have cost far too much.
items.explain_tr: Asıl cümlede üç bilgi var: müze iki yıl kapandı, amaç binanın restorasyonuydu, maliyet ilk tahminin çok üzerine çıktı. C üçünü de korur ([en:meant closing for two years], [en:cost much more than … first calculated]). A kapanma nedenini para yokluğu yapar; B maliyeti süreye çevirir; D ve E müzenin açık kaldığını ya da kalıcı olarak kapandığını söyler.

items.q: Although many employers now offer remote working, surveys suggest that younger employees in particular still value regular face-to-face contact with colleagues.
options: Remote working is widely available today, yet surveys indicate that younger workers especially still appreciate meeting colleagues in person regularly.
Surveys suggest that younger employees prefer remote working because it frees them from regular contact with their colleagues.
Few employers offer remote working, which is why younger employees have so much face-to-face contact with their colleagues.
Older employees, unlike younger ones, still value regular face-to-face contact with colleagues even when remote working is offered.
Surveys show that employers have stopped offering remote working because employees of all ages prefer working in the office.
items.explain_tr: [en:Although] zıtlığı: uzaktan çalışma yaygın olsa da anketlere göre özellikle genç çalışanlar yüz yüze teması hâlâ önemsiyor. A bunu [en:yet] ile ve [en:younger workers especially] diyerek aynen verir. B gençlerin uzaktan çalışmayı tercih ettiğini söyleyerek tersine çevirir; D yüz yüze teması önemseyen grubu yaşlı çalışanlar yapar; C ve E işverenlerin uzaktan çalışma sunmadığını ileri sürer.
